column1: # tools/symgen_manual.tsv — loader-RE'd symbols (highest priority in symgen.py).  name kind edition va
# Found by aligning build_title_drive's call sequence per edition (2026-11-24): the title menu returns the
# chosen action (28 = Continue), the save list returns 12 with (kind, slot, quest) out-params, the list's
# per-frame runner returns 11 back / 12 confirm / 13 again.  SE runs one of two title menus (a flag picks).
# Sandbox ops (2026-11-24).  room_item_add (thiscall room, id, u16 *idx, count, u8 flag, dry; ret 0x14): SE = the
# call inside item_give (0x404a70 / 0x404ac0 +0x266) — SE caps items per category (+0x2ac >= 900 / +0x78 5..8).
# item_table = the static item-definition table (enold 736 B / SE 940 B per record, +0 id, +4 name, 0-id ends);
# SE item_def also searches item_table_ext (a pointer to 0x200 more records).
# map_module = the HMODULE load_room reads map data from (FindResourceA(mod, room record +0xc, "DATA"); 0 = the exe;
# the area table's +4 after its count overrides it).  load_room 0x586b9c / SE 0x5ad169 / JP 0x5aae39.
